digest.component_or_area: Cloud ADF codec and Markdown conversion
propositions: Cloud ADF encode must parse Markdown syntax (headings, lists, code blocks, inline marks) and emit structured ADF nodes rather than literal characters, not just plain-text blocks
The combined strikethrough+strong mark ordering oscillates in a 2-cycle and requires mark-order canonicalization to reach a stable fixed point
HTML comments in Markdown source are dropped by the underlying engine and must be recovered via self-verification fallback to plain encode
Markdown conversion functions must lazy-import marklas with graceful degradation to plain-text adf.py functions when the optional extra is absent, preserving the stdlib-only engine contract
The committed corpus fixture must remain under 500 KB per file and include a scrubbing mechanism to prevent exposure of tenant hostnames, emails, and live URLs
